Structure reproduced from a real Bank Norwegian PDF as extracted by PDF.js.
Merchants, amounts and identifiers are INVENTED - the real statement's spending
history is deliberately not committed. Only the layout quirks are faithful:
  * "MERCHANT ,PLACE" separated by the last comma, sometimes without a space
  * a masked card number in the Kortnr column
  * NOK rows: "<local> NOK <nok>"; foreign rows: "<local> <CUR> <rate> <nok>"
  * the payment row has "-" instead of a card number
  * air ticket rows are followed by passenger/ticket detail lines
